meta.name: ar-status
meta.description: Show experiment dashboard with results, active loops, and progress. Use when the user runs /ar:ar-status or asks how an autoresearch experiment is going.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查看自动研究实验的进度与结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在跑自动研究实验,想随时了解进展。
copy.tagline_en: See the progress and results of your autoresearch experiments at a glance.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run autoresearch experiments and want to check their progress anytime.

howto.what: 调用后，Claude会显示实验仪表盘，列出各实验的运行次数、保留的最佳结果、变化幅度、状态以及循环设置。
howto.when: 当用户输入 /ar:ar-status 命令，或询问自动研究实验进展时触发。

say.text: 查看所有实验的仪表盘。
say.note: Claude 会展示完整仪表盘。

say.text: 看看 engineering/api-speed 实验进展。
say.note: 显示该实验详情和循环状态。

say.text: 把仪表盘导出为 CSV 文件。

howto.what_en: When invoked, Claude displays an experiment dashboard listing runs, kept best results, change, status, and loop settings for each experiment.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user runs /ar:ar-status or asks about the progress of an autoresearch experiment.

say_en.text: Show the dashboard for all experiments.

say_en.note: Shows details and loop status for that experiment.

say_en.text: Export the dashboard as a CSV file.
